description: The agent must: (1) Read case_brief.txt to identify the four arguments made by Respondent's two agents (Article 15 emergency clause, necessity doctrine, proportionality, acquiescence). (2) Write a REBUTTAL section using the exact opening formula 'Your excellencies, the Applicant raises [N] point(s) on rebuttal' — raising no more than 3 points, targeting arguments already made by the Respondent (not introducing new ones). (3) Write a SURREBUTTAL section using the exact opening formula 'Your excellencies, the Respondent has [N] response(s)' — addressing the rebuttal points with the 'Concerning the [ordinal] point mentioned by the Applicant, the Respondent submits that...' structure. (4) Write the time-extension request using the correct variant for when time HAS ALREADY expired: 'I note my time has run out, may I have 1 more minute...' — critically NOT using the 'my time is running out' variant (which is for when 30 seconds remain, not when time is fully expired). The proprietary trap: generic agents will miss the two-variant distinction for time requests, will use wrong opening formulas for rebuttal/surrebuttal, may introduce new arguments in the rebuttal, or may raise too many rebuttal points.
